instruction: I went on a dinner with some of my friends yesterday. I paid the entire bill to simplify the payment. I've made a note of individual shares in simple note. Some people have already sent me their share on venmo. Make payment requests for others with a description note "Friends Dinner".
notes: The actual friend names, shares, and who has already paid are only known at runtime (note content, phone contacts, venmo transactions). The problem assumes a representative instance: three friends listed in the 'Friends Dinner' note, one (dinner-friend-1) has already sent a 'Friends Dinner' venmo transaction, two (dinner-friend-2, dinner-friend-3) are pending and must each get a payment request for their note share with description 'Friends Dinner'. Hidden data (contact emails, note shares, already-paid status) is encoded as static init facts but is only usable after the corresponding lookup flags (contacts-searched, note-read, transactions-checked) are set by phone.search_contacts, simple_note.show_note and venmo.show_transactions; create_payment_request is blocked for anyone already paid and cannot be duplicated. Pending friends, their amounts and the description are domain constants so that supervisor-complete-task's precondition can state the goal conditions; they are not re-declared in the problem. Pagination, sort_by and the note date filter are handled at runtime (search_notes requires current-datetime-known for the 'created since yesterday' selection).
